news_analysis.headline_hook: SME IPO Reality Check: 1 Lot ₹1.4 Lakhs Investment 50% Drop Aana Flat-a ₹70,000 Loss Out!
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Recent data reveals that while 21 SME IPOs in 2026 delivered multibagger returns, a significant portion of the cohort simultaneously inflicted losses of up to 50% on retail investors.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors view the 21 multibaggers as proof of 'easy money' and a repeatable strategy, ignoring the survivorship bias inherent in the SME segment.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: The SME market suffers from extreme liquidity constraints and 'pump-and-dump' volatility; institutions use these IPOs for quick exit liquidity, leaving retail holding the bag on illiquid, low-float stocks that lack institutional research coverage.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never allocate more than 2% of your total portfolio to the entire SME segment, and treat every SME IPO as a speculative venture capital bet, not an investment.

slides.title: SME IPO Reality Check: 1 Lot ₹1.4 Lakhs Investment 50% Drop Aana Flat-a ₹70,000 Loss Out!
The Retail Trap: FOMO vs Reality
slides.card_text: Retail investors 21 multibaggers-ah mattum paathu 'easy money' nu ninaikiraanga. Aana, 50% varai loss aagum bodhu, exit panna kooda liquidity irukkadhu. Idhu oru trap!

slides.title: The Hidden Math: Survivorship Bias
slides.card_text: SME market-la 21 multibaggers irundhalum, adhu survivorship bias. Neraya stocks listing-ku aprom volume illama 50% varai value-ah izhandhurukku. Math-ah paatha, risk reward ratio retail-ku against-ah irukku.

slides.title: Why It Compounds Against Retail
slides.card_text: SME stocks-la low float irukkum. Konjam sell pressure vandhalum stock price free-fall aagum. Institutional research coverage illadhadhu retail-ku blind spot-ah mudiyudhu.

slides.title: Institutional Reality: Exit Liquidity
slides.card_text: Institutions SME IPO-va quick exit liquidity-kaga use panraanga. Retail investors-ah 'bag holders'-ah maathi, avanga profit-ah book pannitu veliya vandhuruvaanga. Idhu oru pump-and-dump game.

slides.title: The Golden Protective Rule
slides.card_text: Never allocate more than 2% of your total portfolio to the entire SME segment. Treat every SME IPO as a speculative venture capital bet, not a long-term investment.

slides.title: Pre-Trade Action Checklist
slides.card_text: 1. Check the promoter background. 2. Verify if the company has positive cash flow. 3. Ensure you can afford to lose 100% of the capital invested.
